name: @sos-2/real-bodies
description: SOS 2.0 Real Cloud Execution Bodies (Work Order P17-B): real cloud/remote execution bodies behind the EXISTING frozen P5 §9 HarnessContract — the body abstraction remains UNCHANGED and no vendor becomes part of SOS semantics. The HostedCodingBody is a hosted coding-harness body that executes a durable task's work program by driving a REAL coding-capable model API (OpenRouter through the injectable HostedModelPort) inside its bounded sandbox: the synchronous §9 surface is the control/read plane (bounded workspace, the model-backed shell vocabulary, git typed records, artifacts, observations, the cursor event stream) and the documented async engine (runWorkProgram) is the operator-driven provider-side drive — the frozen P8 sync-seam composition discipline. Model outputs are parsed by a bounded protocol and applied inside the sandbox; they are NEVER authoritative (a body cannot self-certify — the independent evaluator gates completion, pinned by test). Placement 'cloud': the user's computer is NEVER required (no device handle; egress allowlist carries only the model provider — pinned by test and asserted in evidence). Bodies remain REPLACEABLE: the same task graph runs against the reference cloud body and this real body with identical contract behavior (pinned by test). The async->sync REAL provider session bridge (github-bridge.ts) attaches the real @sos-2/real-github provider behind the P8 repository-operations seam exactly as that frozen seam documented. Deterministic reference-mode: scripted model port, offline, fixed seed, no hidden clocks, no ambient environment access; network happens only in the env-gated integration suite (RUN_REAL=1). ZERO external dependencies: workspace:* + the existing toolchain only.
